summary: One week to the workshop: you hunt bugs with a probe of awkward requests, rank them by who is hurt and how likely, and fix the top three small ones, each with a test that fails first. Real run on the capstone: vote stuffing, an exception message in a 400, and a health check that said ok with the service down. Two limits are written down instead of fixed.

items.text: Add scripts/probe.py with the routes of your system and run it
Add three awkward cases of your own and predict each status first
Stop the service behind your front door and see whether your health check tells the truth
Rank what you found by who is hurt, how likely and how big the fix
Fix the top three small ones, each with a test that fails first
Write the bugs you will not fix as known limits in the README
Play the Bug Hunt game to the end and see your score
